Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

Heard Sri Mohd. Waris Farooqui, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sanjay Srivastava,
the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 11 of 2023, under Sections 366, 376, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Aalapur, District Ambedkar Nagar.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 05.01.2023 at about 14:30 hours, alleging that on 04.01.2023 at about 04:00 hours, the informant's daughter Pooja had gone to the house of co-accused Furqan and the informant's younger daughter had seen her there but when she did not return after some time, the informnat's wife went there and found that the house was locked and she could not know whereabouts her daughter Pooja.

The alleged victim was recovered on 05.01.2023 itself and in her statement she stated that she is aged about 19 years, she used to talk to the applicant for the past one year, the applicant threatened to commit suicide because of which the victim started making physical relations with him.
On 01.01.2023, the applicant gave a mobile phone to the victim and on 04.01.2023 at about 04:00 p.m, he called her to Qasim vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

She stated that the applicant took her to Azamgarh where his maternal aunt was there, from where the police brought her back.
The victim was taken for medico legal examination, but she declined to undergo the same.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim gave a similar version.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that victim is major, she stated that she used to talk to the applicant for about one year and that she has declined to undergo medico legal examination, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 07.01.2023, without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case
, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
